faqs.q: Can blurred text in a screenshot be unblurred or read?
faqs.a: It depends on the method used. If text is blurred with client-side CSS or HTML filters on a website, anyone can inspect element and remove the filter. If text in a flattened image is subjected to a light Gaussian blur (radius < 6px), machine learning font-matching algorithms can sometimes reconstruct probable letters. However, with solid black box redaction, the original pixel values are permanently overwritten and destroyed, making unblurring mathematically impossible.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Gaussian blur and solid censor blocks?
faqs.a: Gaussian blur averages adjacent pixel color values, creating a soft, out-of-focus aesthetic ideal for teasers, non-sensitive social media posts, and design mockups. Solid black censor blocks completely replace underlying pixels with opaque color blocks, ensuring true cryptographic destruction for passwords, credit card numbers, OTPs, and government IDs.

faqs.q: How do I blur text in an image without Photoshop?
faqs.a: Simply open AnyOnlineTools Blur Text in any desktop or mobile browser. Press Ctrl+V to paste your screenshot directly from your clipboard (or tap Upload Image), drag a rectangle over the words you want to conceal, select Blur, Pixelate, or Solid Box, and tap Download to save your clean redacted image in seconds.

faqs.q: Are my uploaded screenshots and sensitive documents saved on your servers?
faqs.a: Never. AnyOnlineTools processes 100% of image rendering, pixelation, and text blurring locally in your device's browser memory using HTML5 Canvas. Your images are never transmitted over the internet, never saved to any database, and leave zero traces when you close your browser tab.

faqs.q: Does this tool strip GPS location and camera EXIF metadata from photos?
faqs.a: Yes. When you download a redacted screenshot or photo, the HTML5 Canvas exporter reconstructs the pixel bitmap from scratch and automatically strips all hidden camera EXIF tags, GPS latitude/longitude coordinates, and device timestamps, preventing accidental location leaks before you share photos online.

faqs.q: Why is drawing black highlighter on iPhone photos unsafe for redaction?
faqs.a: The default iOS Markup highlighter pen operates with approximately 80% opacity rather than 100% solid opacity. Anyone who saves your highlighted photo can simply increase the exposure and brightness settings in photo editing apps to easily read the text beneath the mark. Our Solid Censor mode guarantees 100% opaque, impenetrable pixel destruction.

faqs.q: How can web developers blur text using CSS?
faqs.a: You can blur HTML text elements by applying 'filter: blur(5px); user-select: none;'. To ensure cross-browser compatibility across older mobile engines, you can also use Chris Coyier's classic CSS-Tricks fallback: 'color: transparent; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);'. Both snippets are available with 1-click copy inside our Developer Drawer.

faqs.q: Does blurring text reduce the overall resolution or quality of my screenshot?
faqs.a: No. AnyOnlineTools operates on your image at 100% native resolution. Only the exact pixel boundaries of the rectangular or circular mask you draw are modified, while all surrounding text, headers, and UI elements maintain their original crystal-clear clarity.

faqs.q: What is blank text / invisible character and how does it work?
faqs.a: Blank text is a valid Unicode character that displays completely empty on screen but is recognized by computer systems, web forms, and messaging algorithms as legitimate content. Unlike standard spacebar spaces (ASCII U+0020) which get collapsed or stripped by form sanitizers, special characters like Braille Pattern Blank (U+2800) and Hangul Filler (U+3164) are classified as symbols or letters, allowing them to bypass input trim checks.

faqs.q: Why does the regular spacebar fail when sending empty messages or saving gamer names?
faqs.a: When you press the spacebar on your keyboard, it generates a standard space separator (U+0020). Chat apps like WhatsApp and games like Free Fire run an automated trim function (e.g., input.trim().length === 0) on submission. Because U+0020 is a whitespace character, it gets stripped to zero length, disabling the Send button or rejecting the username. Our tool uses Braille Blank (U+2800) and Hangul Filler (U+3164), which are categorized as symbols and letters, so they are never stripped.

faqs.q: How do I send an empty or blank message on WhatsApp and Telegram?
faqs.a: Click our 1-click 'Copy Blank Text' button (which automatically copies the Braille Blank U+2800 character), or simply click our direct 'Send to WhatsApp' or 'Send to Telegram' button. When the chat window opens, the blank character is pre-filled, the Send button turns active, and you can send an authentic empty speech bubble with one tap.

faqs.q: How do I get an invisible nickname in Free Fire (FF), PUBG Mobile, and Discord?
faqs.a: Select our 'Gaming & Nicknames' preset (which uses Hangul Filler U+3164) and click Copy. Paste the character into your game's Name Change Card. Because Free Fire and PUBG anticheats classify U+3164 as a valid Korean alphabet letter block rather than illegal whitespace, your in-game name registers as completely invisible without triggering an 'Invalid Character' error.

faqs.q: Will I get banned in Free Fire, PUBG, or Discord for using an invisible name?
faqs.a: No. Using Hangul Filler (U+3164) is 100% safe and ban-free. It is an official international Unicode standard letter (Category Lo - Letter, other). It does not alter game memory, inject third-party scripts, or exploit game vulnerabilities. Anticheat systems recognize it as standard text, making it completely compliant with terms of service.

faqs.q: What should I do if my invisible name says 'Nickname Already Taken'?
faqs.a: If another player in your guild or server has already registered an invisible name using U+3164, use our 'Halfwidth Hangul Filler' (U+FFA0). While both look 100% identical and transparent on screen, they represent distinct Unicode code points, allowing you to bypass the duplicate username restriction.

faqs.q: How do I create clean line breaks in Instagram and TikTok bios without ugly dots?
faqs.a: Instagram and TikTok automatically collapse empty line breaks into a single line if there is no text. By copying a single invisible character and pasting it on the empty line between your paragraphs, the platform detects content and preserves your clean aesthetic vertical spacing without requiring awkward periods (.), hyphens (-), or emoji placeholders.
